findings.title: Concurrent reader is neither synchronized with nor awaited by the test
findings.body: The test starts a raw reader thread but never waits for it to begin issuing requests or to terminate. The deleting thread can delete all groups and set `deletedAll` before the reader is scheduled at all, so this test can pass without exercising the concurrent access race. Conversely, a request already in progress can add an exception after the assertion at line 157 has run. Coordinate startup (for example with a latch) and join/await the reader after setting the stop flag before asserting the captured failures.
